browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, 1280x900, one browser context per identity

steps.action: Register step 1: open Entities; its first view is Calendar; select List
steps.expected: Entities opens on the Compliance calendar; List shows the registry table.
steps.actual: Entities opened at /entities with the Compliance calendar heading (Calendar link aria-current=page). List moved to ?view=list and showed a table headed "Legal name Type Jurisdiction Registration no. Status Portal-listed Next obligation".

steps.action: Register step 2: Search entities by name; Filter with Type, Status, Jurisdiction, Majority owner (one value, Apply, chips); Clear all
steps.expected: Search narrows by name; each filter takes one value and shows a chip; Clear all removes every filter.
steps.actual: Search "DOC-032 compat compat-c Admin folders Entity 09280715 Ltd" left 1 matching row(s). Filter listed ["Type","Status","Jurisdiction","Majority owner","Show archived"]. Type LLC then Status Active (one radio value each, Apply) showed chips ["Type: LLC","Status: Active"] and left 8 of 34 rows, all LLC and Active. Jurisdiction "Brazil" left 1 rows with that jurisdiction. Majority owner "Helix Analytics, Inc." showed chip "Majority owner: Helix Analytics, Inc." and left 1 rows. Clear all removed every chip and returned 34 rows.

steps.action: Refusals: Register with no Legal name, then no Entity type
steps.expected: The dialog shows 'Name the entity — its registered legal name.' then 'Pick an entity type.'; nothing is created.
steps.actual: Register with nothing showed "Name the entity — its registered legal name."; with a name but no type it showed "Pick an entity type." and the dialog stayed open. Registry rows for the prefix stayed 0.

steps.action: Register step 5: a type whose Form requires a Field for creation shows it after the identity details; blank gives 'Fill {Field}'; filled, it saves
steps.expected: Local counsel appears after Registered address; blank shows 'Fill Local counsel.'; filled, Register saves it on the record.
steps.actual: Before a type was chosen the dialog had no Local counsel control. Choosing "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 required type" added Local counsel after Registered address. Register with it blank showed "Fill Local counsel.". Filled, Register saved "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Required Field Ltd" with Local counsel "Harbour & Pike LLP (fictional)".

steps.action: Register steps 3-4, 6-8: Add entity with identity details, Status default Active, Portal-listed (Administrators only, off by default), Attach documents with a Document type, Register, open it; creator Grant
steps.expected: Status defaults to Active; Portal-listed shows only to Administrators and is off; the attached file lands on the new Entity; the adder holds a Grant.
steps.actual: Add entity opened with Status Active. Portal-listed in the dialog: not shown. Attach documents took doc030-entities-certificate.pdf (no Document type choice was offered). Register saved "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings"; opened from List it read {"Formation jurisdiction":"Republic of Aldoria","Formed on":"2019-03-14","Registration no.":"ALD-L-0928-0715","Tax ID":"TX-L-0928-0715","Registered agent":"Aldoria Corporate Agents","Registered address":"1 Harbour Row, Port Aldo"} and Status Active. Manage access was offered and the access list named ["Nadia Haddad"]. Portal card: "Portal Portal-listed Only an Administrator can change Portal-listed." (switch on=false, disabled=true). The Documents tab listed "doc030-entities-certificate.pdf — v1 Sep 28 Uploaded by Nadia Haddad NH".

steps.action: Register step 8: change a field and move focus away; a selection saves when chosen; Status Dormant does not archive
steps.expected: Registered agent saves on blur; Status Dormant saves on selection; no Archived mark; Archive still offered.
steps.actual: After a reload Registered agent read "Aldoria Registered Agents Ltd" and Status read Dormant. The header still offered Archive and showed no Archived mark.

steps.action: Names are not unique: registering the same legal name again creates another Entity
steps.expected: A second Register with the same name creates a distinct record; the first is unchanged.
steps.actual: Searching the name listed 2 rows linking to 2 records: ["DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings Corporation Republic of Aldoria ALD-L-0928-0715 Dormant No —","DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings LLC Duchy of Kessel — Active No —"]. The first kept Republic of Aldoria and Dormant.

steps.action: Parties step 1: choose Our entity on a Contract; check the saved name; Not known yet clears it
steps.expected: Our entity saves the chosen Entity; Not known yet clears it; both survive reload.
steps.actual: C-66 Our entity read "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings" after a reload. Not known yet read "Not known yet" after a reload (stored entity null). It was then set back to "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings".

steps.action: Parties steps 2-3: type a new name and select Create "<name>"; the first Counterparty is Primary
steps.expected: Create adds the new Counterparty with the Primary mark.
steps.actual: The picker offered Create "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd" and it added the Counterparty. After a reload the Contract showed 1 Primary mark; parties ["DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd"], primary "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd".

steps.action: Parties step 4: add another Counterparty and Make primary
steps.expected: Make primary moves the Primary mark.
steps.actual: After Make primary and a reload the primary Counterparty was "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Birch Logistics"; parties ["DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Birch Logistics","DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd"].

steps.action: Picker rules: an exact existing name in another case offers no creation; a Counterparty on the Contract is not offered again
steps.expected: No Create row for the case variant; the attached party is not listed.
steps.actual: Typing "DOC-032 COMPAT COMPAT-C V-C31 0928-0715 L CEDAR SUPPLY LTD" listed ["No counterparties to add."]: no Create row, and DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd (already on the Contract) was not offered.

steps.action: Parties step 5: Take <name> off the contract; the next remaining takes Primary; the shared record remains; the final removal leaves none
steps.expected: Removing the Primary passes the mark; the shared Counterparty remains; removing the last shows no Counterparties.
steps.actual: Take DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Birch Logistics off the contract left ["DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd"] with DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd Primary. Typing "DOC-032 COMPAT COMPAT-C V-C31 0928-0715 L BIRCH LOGISTICS" again offered the shared record and no Create row (["DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Birch Logistics"]). Taking DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Cedar Supply Ltd off showed "Nobody is recorded on the other side yet.".

steps.action: Recovery: an archived Entity is not offered for a new selection; an existing Contract keeps its reference
steps.expected: Archive the chosen Entity; Our entity still shows it on the Contract; another Contract does not offer it.
steps.actual: With the first "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings" archived, C-66 still showed "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C31 0928-0715 L Aldoria Holdings". On C-74 Our entity offered 1 option with that name, the live duplicate, not the archived record. The Entity was then restored.
